sources.title: Introducing Mistral 3
sources.evidence: Dated December 2, 2025. Releases the 14B Ministral 3 model as one of three dense sizes, with separate base, instruct and reasoning variants, native image understanding, Apache 2.0 licensing and local deployment. Distinguishes the larger Mistral Large 3 MoE model.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B — exact API model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies API names ministral-14b-2512 and ministral-14b-latest, version 25.12 and December 2, 2025 release. Freshly read rendered React payload: the Instruct Weights row links Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512 and separately labels Parameters (B)=14 and Active (B)=14, Apache 2.0 and 256k context. Other rows separately link Reasoning and Base checkpoints.

sources.title: Mistral API changelog
sources.evidence: The December 2, 2025 entry explicitly releases ministral-14b-2512 together with the other Ministral 3 API sizes. This independently verifies the dated API identity and release date.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512 — pinned official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the FP8 instruction-post-trained checkpoint. Reports a 13.5B language component and 0.4B vision encoder as rounded components, native function calling, JSON output, text/image understanding, 256k context and Apache 2.0. Lists distinct Base, Instruct and Reasoning repositories; reasoning benchmark rows are not transferred to this instruct variant.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct — pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration combines a dense ministral3 text decoder with a Pixtral vision encoder/projector. Text decoder has 40 layers, hidden size 5120, feed-forward size 16384, 32 query and 8 KV heads, 131072 vocabulary and max_position_embeddings 262144; YaRN factor 16 from 16384. Vision encoder has 24 layers. FP8 quantization excludes the vision tower, projector and language head.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct — pinned native configuration
sources.evidence: Native Mistral configuration independently confirms dense dimensions, 262144 maximum positions, FP8 weight quantization and the native vision encoder/projector.

sources.title: Ministral 3 — technical report
sources.evidence: The later Mistral report identifies Ministral 3 as a dense decoder-only Transformer family and separately tabulates the 14B architecture: 40 layers, width 5120, 32/8 query/KV heads, FFN width 16384, untied embeddings and 256k context. The vision section reports a 410M ViT plus a separately trained projection. It distinguishes instruction and reasoning post-training.

sources.title: Maintainer correction of unused reasoning tokens
sources.evidence: Mistral organization maintainer Julien Denize explicitly calls this exact Instruct checkpoint non-reasoning. June 30, 2026 merged change replaces unused THINK tokens with reserved slots to prevent tooling from treating it as reasoning-capable. Commit 706ed972053cc1c25eed1a2a22f7fd85b34aa8d1 changes tokenizer files only.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B — official Markdown model reference
sources.evidence: Successfully fetched directly. Lists exact dated API ID, text/image input, text output, native function calling, 256k context, Apache 2.0 and separate Instruct, Reasoning and Base weight links.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current repository is public and ungated at revision 29439f81c2be264d8d393273f99e7db9c0961120. Its files include both native and Transformers safetensors weights and exact configuration files. The Transformers index references four shards.

sources.title: Official checkpoint — bounded public-access probe
sources.evidence: An unauthenticated byte-range request returned HTTP 206, Content-Range bytes 0-7/4980912374, and exactly eight bytes. The safetensors header-length value is 22560. No full shard was downloaded.

sources.title: OpenRouter model metadata for exact ministralai/ministral-14b-2512
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-ID record names Ministral 3 14B 2512 and explicitly sets hugging_face_id to mistralai/Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512. Used as a provider identity bridge, not to establish architecture or counts. The linked exact endpoint response identifies Mistral routes and 262144 context.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct — pinned checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: The four-shard index lists 1145 tensors, including dense decoder projections, vision/projector weights and FP8 activation/weight scales. This confirms the component structure but is not an exact learned-parameter census.

name.note: Retain the dated catalog display name: developer product name Ministral 3 14B plus the fixed 2512 revision. The official API identifier is ministral-14b-2512.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the model and checkpoint; preserve the normalized developer label.

family.note: The model is in the Ministral 3 family, distinct from Mistral Large 3 and the older Ministral generation.

release_date.note: The dated launch, exact model reference and explicit API release changelog agree.

open_weights.note: The documented Instruct checkpoint is public and ungated; actual unauthenticated weight retrieval succeeded using a bounded request.

license.note: Exact instruct model card and official weights row explicitly identify Apache 2.0; normalize the license name.

parameters_b.note: Use the developer-published nominal whole-model count in billions. Card components 13.5B language and 0.4B vision are rounded; do not sum them into an asserted exact count or substitute FP8 storage elements.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact Instruct Weights row directly labels Active (B)=14. This is nominal disclosure, not an assumption that dense active count equals total.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only language Transformer with grouped-query attention, Pixtral vision encoder and projection. Confirmed independently by the exact configs and the report’s 14B architecture row; no MoE inference.

context_window.note: Both checkpoint configurations explicitly specify 262144 positions, agreeing with the developer’s nominal 256k context. This does not claim a successful live authenticated API invocation.

modalities.note: Exact API docs enumerate text/image input and text output; checkpoint includes the native vision encoder and language generation head.

reasoning.note: Assess the Instruct checkpoint documented alongside this dated API model and explicitly linked by the exact provider record. Its Mistral maintainer directly states non-reasoning. The separately released Reasoning checkpoint and its benchmark results are not transferred.

tool_call.note: Native function calling is explicit in the exact API reference and instruction checkpoint card, including Mistral tool-parser examples.

description.value: Instruction-tuned text and image model with native function calling, designed for local and edge deployment.
description.note: Restrict description to documented modalities, instruction tuning, tools and intended deployment; omit unsupported latency or comparative-cost claims.

patch.notes: The dated ministral-14b-2512 entry corresponds to the documented Instruct model; the separately released Reasoning checkpoint is a different variant. Mistral directly reports nominal 14B total and 14B active parameters. The card gives rounded components of 13.5B for the language model and 0.4B for vision; these are not an exact whole-checkpoint census. FP8 storage and scale tensors are not learned-parameter counts. Both configurations specify 262,144 positions. The Instruct checkpoint is explicitly non-reasoning, with native text/image input and function calling.

summary: Individually audited all 14 fields of the dated Ministral 14B 2512 record. Exact primary docs and changelog establish the API identity and December 2 release. Retain nominal 14B total with primary provenance, add separately disclosed 14B active, dense architecture and Apache-2.0. Confirm 262144 context, text/image input, native tools and explicitly non-reasoning Instruct checkpoint. Public weights verified with eight bytes. Distinguish the separate Reasoning variant and rounded component counts; replace generic latency/cost description.
